headline_marked: Brazilian star [[Casemiro signs with Inter Miami]] to join Messi and Suarez
headline: Brazilian star Casemiro signs with Inter Miami to join Messi and Suarez
summary: The 34-year-old midfielder, a five-time Champions League winner, joins the MLS side after five years with Manchester United.
details: Inter Miami has officially announced the signing of Brazilian superstar midfielder Casemiro. The 34-year-old joins forces with Lionel Messi and Luis Suarez, his former rivals at FC Barcelona.
Casemiro arrives in Miami after a five-year stint with Premier League side Manchester United. His contract runs through 2027, with an option to extend until June 2029.

The Brazilian international has an extraordinary track record, including 21 club trophies and five UEFA Champions League titles. He recorded 73 goals and 61 assists in 663 club appearances for Sao Paulo, Real Madrid, Porto and Manchester United.
Casemiro recently helped Brazil reach the round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, bringing his national team totals to 91 caps and 10 goals.

Managing owner Jorge Mas described Casemiro's arrival as a reflection of the club's ambition to become a global benchmark. Co-owner David Beckham also welcomed the player, praising his winning mentality.
Inter Miami, the defending MLS Cup champions, currently sit second in the Eastern Conference. They are return from the World Cup break to face the Chicago Fire on Wednesday night.
caption:
A new superstar arrives in Miami! 🇧🇷

Casemiro joins Messi and Suarez to create one of the most formidable midfields in league history.

Casemiro recently helped Brazil reach the round of 16 at the 2026 FIFA World Cup, bringing his national team totals to 91 caps and 10 goals.

Managing owner Jorge Mas described Casemiro's arrival as a reflection of the club's ambition to become a global benchmark. Co-owner David Beckham also welcomed the player, praising his winning mentality.

Inter Miami, the defending MLS Cup champions, currently sit second in the Eastern Conference. They are return from the World Cup break to face the Chicago Fire on Wednesday night.

headline_marked: Mymensingh: [[Missing youth's decapitated body found]] buried in ground
headline: Mymensingh: Missing youth's decapitated body found buried in ground
summary: Sohel Mia, 26, went missing on July 16. His remains were discovered by college staff after they noticed a foul smell near a construction site.
details: Sohel Mia, a 26-year-old tree-cutting laborer, was found dead in Mymensingh after being missing for seven days. His decapitated body was discovered buried in the ground near an academic building construction site of Ambikaganj College.
caption:
A foul smell led to the discovery of a missing youth's decapitated body buried in Mymensingh.

Sohel Mia, a 26-year-old tree-cutting laborer, was found dead in Mymensingh after being missing for seven days. His decapitated body was discovered buried in the ground near an academic building construction site of Ambikaganj College.
